question:
Select the figure that will come next in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/89b3745e41cc32fb015bdd85a7afe082f4c8148fd535c61a021b5f0888033b2a.png]
solution:
The pattern followed here is :

 
• Arrow is shifting clockwise at the edge of box.
 
• Circle is shifting anti-clockwise at the corner of box.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c341f242ceb1eb795b7b5bde09bb376072eda4619dfef2482ea95cd555dd491e.png] 

Similarly, next figure will be.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5d99817dd6c2c1b5e57d6e418f22b1874c88c177d1827b8c61576580ff18b196.png] 

Hence, **'Option 1'** is the correct answer.
